data.name: Dance of Fury
data.description: At 12th level, a dervish dancer can attack more than once as he moves while performing a battle dance. He can combine a full attack action with a single move, taking the attacks at any point during his movement, but must move at least 5 feet between each attack. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal. This ability replaces soothing performance.
